wish: someone should make an app that removes passers-by by combining several photos of the same scene
spec:
Combines 3 or more photos of the same scene with a per-pixel median, so anyone who moved between shots disappears.
Add shots taken from the same spot (hand-held shots are lined up automatically), tap Remove passers-by, save the clean PNG.
It does not remove people who stay put in most shots, and nothing leaves the device.

expect.matches: Done\. Combined 5 photos\. (99\.\d|100\.0)% of pixels match the empty scene

notes: Works fully offline. Photos are downscaled to 1600px on the long side for memory.
